hook_line: ASHUTOSH DIXIT TAKES CHARGE AS 29TH IAF CHIEF

hook_stat.sub: Chief of the Air Staff of the Indian Air Force

stats.label: Hours of flying experience as a fighter and experimental test pilot
Of service completed by A.P. Singh before he superannuated
Dixit's tenure as Air Chief runs until December 31 of that year

diaspora_bullets: He held the IAF's joint-staff post during Operation Sindoor
He was instrumental in the LCA Mk-I Tejas operational clearances
news_summary: Air Chief Marshal Ashutosh Dixit assumed charge as the 29th Chief of the Air Staff on October 31, succeeding A.P. Singh, who superannuated after 42 years of service.
payoff: Dixit, who held the joint-staff post during Operation Sindoor, now leads the IAF through its next phase of aircraft induction and air-defence strengthening.
